entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments: ¶Wisdom has made her house, putting up her seven pillars.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: She has put her fat beasts to death; her wine is mixed, her table is ready.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: She has sent out her women-servants; her voice goes out to the highest places of the town, saying,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:4
segments: Whoever is simple, let him come in here; and to him who has no sense, she says:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:5
segments: Come, take of my bread, and of my wine which is mixed.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:6
segments: Give up the simple ones and have life, and go in the way of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: He who gives teaching to a man of pride gets shame for himself; he who says sharp words to a sinner gets a bad name.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: Do not say sharp words to a man of pride, or he will have hate for you; make them clear to a wise man, and you will be dear to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:9
segments: Give teaching to a wise man, and he will become wiser; give training to an upright man, and his learning will be increased.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:10
segments: The fear of the Lord is the start of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One gives a wise mind

entries.title: Proverbs 9:11
segments: For by me your days will be increased, and the years of your life will be long.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if your heart is full of pride, you only will have the pain of it.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:13
segments: ¶The foolish woman is full of noise; she has no sense at all.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: Seated at the door of her house, in the high places of the town,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: Crying out to those who go by, going straight on their way, she says:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: Whoever is simple, let him come in here: and to him who is without sense, she says:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: Drink taken without right is sweet, and food in secret is pleasing.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:18
segments: But he does not see that the dead are there, that her guests are in the deep places of the underworld.
